map.摄氧动力学半时是做什么的？: What does VO2 Kinetics Half-Time do?
map.如何使用摄氧动力学半时？: How do I use VO2 Kinetics Half-Time?
map.摄氧动力学半时适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is VO2 Kinetics Half-Time best for?
map.输入安静 VO2、目标(稳态)VO2 与达到 50% 变化的时间，计算摄氧动力学: Enter resting VO2, target (steady-state) VO2, and the time to reach 50% of the change to compute the VO2 kinetics time constant τ, the half-time, and the time to reach each percentage of steady state, evaluating aerobic response speed.
map.💡 摄氧动力学：VO2(t)=VO2_rest + ΔVO2×(1−e^(−t/: 💡 VO2 kinetics: VO2(t) = VO2_rest + ΔVO2×(1−e^(−t/τ)); half-time t50 = τ×ln2, so τ = t50÷0.693. 63% ≈ τ, 95% ≈ 3τ, 99% ≈ 5τ. Trained athletes have phase II τ of about 15-20 s; healthy adults 20-30 s.
map.安静 VO2 一般 200~300 ml/min，目标 VO2 为运动稳态摄氧量: Resting VO2 is typically 200-300 ml/min; target VO2 is the exercise steady-state oxygen uptake
map.达到50%时间指从安静到稳态变化量的 50% 所需秒数: Time to 50% is the seconds needed to reach 50% of the change from rest to steady state
map.τ 反映有氧代谢响应速度，越小响应越快: τ reflects the speed of aerobic metabolic response; the smaller, the faster
map.相位Ⅱ(基础成分) τ 健康成人约 20~30s，耐力运动员更短: Phase II (primary component) τ is about 20-30 s in healthy adults, shorter in endurance athletes
map.运动开始摄氧升至稳态的半时。: The half-time for VO2 rising to steady state at exercise onset.
map.有氧能力评估用 VO2 半时反映 onset 快慢，半时短者次极量更省力。: Aerobic assessment uses the VO2 half-time to reflect onset speed; a shorter half-time means submaximal work feels easier.
map.中等强度摄氧半时约 30 s；快肌多者更快但氧亏大。: Moderate-intensity VO2 half-time is about 30 s; those with more fast-twitch fibers are faster but incur a larger oxygen deficit.
map.摄氧滞后于需求的亏欠，由无氧供能补。: The shortfall when oxygen uptake lags demand, covered by anaerobic energy supply.
map.半时短有什么好处？: What are the benefits of a short half-time?
map.进入稳态快、氧债小，间歇与变速项目恢复更迅捷，耐受性更好。: Faster entry into steady state and a smaller oxygen debt mean quicker recovery and better tolerance in interval and variable-pace events.
map.摄氧动力学半时计算工具，输入安静 VO2、目标(稳态)VO2 与达到 50% 变: The VO2 Kinetics Half-Time tool takes resting VO2, target (steady-state) VO2, and the time to reach 50% of the change, and computes the time constant τ, half-time t50, and the time to reach 63%/95%/99% of steady state, evaluating the aerobic response speed at exercise onset.
map.基于指数模型计算时间常数 τ: Time constant τ from an exponential model
map.输出达各百分比稳态时间: Outputs time to each percentage of steady state
